label: kizuna_friend_d_03
text: Gwah! I was focusing so hard, I didn’t even\nnotice you, bud![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_04
text: Hehe... I know, I know. Pretty rare to see me\nactually studying, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_05
text: But I’m at a pretty good stopping point. How\nabout a break? I could use a change of scenery.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_06
text: What do you think? Welcome to Chez Arven!\nWell, Chez Arven and Mabosstiff, really.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_select_01
text: It really screams “Arven”![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_select_02
text: It’s surprisingly clean![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_07a
text: Hehehe... Yeah, I know, right?\c\nWait—what screams “Arven” to you?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_07b
text: Why’s that surprising?! I’ll have you know that I\nclean every single day!\c\nMostly ’cause Mabosstiff sheds a ton, but still...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_08
text: Anyway, uh... About the reason you saw me\nstudying in the classroom like that...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_09a
text: I went back and read the pages about the Herba\nMystica in the Scarlet Book again.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_09b
text: I went back and read the pages about the Herba\nMystica in the Violet Book again.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_10
text: It made me remember how things were back\nwhen Mabosstiff was all weak and everything.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_11
text: I couldn’t seem to do anything to help him, and...\nboy, it sure didn’t feel good.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_12
text: ’Course, I’m really glad that I was able to find\nall the Herba Mystica together with you.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_13
text: But there’s got to be other people who are still\nsuffering the same way I was back then, worrying\r\nabout their Pokémon that’re sick or hurt.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_14
text: So... So I...I, uh...\c\nDon’t laugh, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_15
text: I’ve decided that I...I’m gonna become a cook![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_16
text: I’m gonna make super healthy food, bursting\nfull of the stuff Pokémon need to feel great![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_select_03
text: I’ll be behind you all the way!

label: kizuna_friend_d_select_04
text: I’m sure you can pull it off!

label: kizuna_friend_d_17
text: Yeah! And thanks. I knew I could count on you\nto be all supportive like that.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_18a
text: The culinary world might be a bit different, but\nI swear—I’m gonna be just as famous as my mom![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_18b
text: The culinary world might be a bit different, but\nI swear—I’m gonna be just as famous as my dad![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_19
text: So I guess I can close the book on my little\nhunt to find myself.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_20
text: It’s time to start a new chapter—one that’s\nall about working toward my new dream![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_21
text: And hey, feel free to stop by my room anytime.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_22
text: Mabosstiff will always be glad to see you.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_d_poke_01
text: Ruff! Woof!
